purpose: Primary whole-book qualification corpus for S.A.G.A. narrative analysis. Measure candidates on the modern fantasy/YA/romantasy books that historically exposed S.A.G.A.'s real identity-resolution failure modes rather than using public-domain literary benchmarks as the product acceptance target.
sourcePolicy: All source books are user-owned/private copyrighted material. The repository stores metadata only. Operators provision the EPUBs outside the repository; every execution hashes the exact bytes used. Source text, extracted chapters, or reconstructive excerpts must never be committed or published in benchmark artifacts.
